[# Pablo Hernando-Kaminsky]: #

::: {.justified}

I am an economist in the Economics and Market Research Department of the International Finance Corporation. Previously, I was a Postdoctoral Associate in the Macroeconomics and Growth Unit of the Development Research Group at the World Bank. I obtained my PhD in Economics from Johns Hopkins University in 2023.

My research interests lie at the intersection of international finance and macroeconomics.
